notes.title: Soundtrack & Card revamp!
notes.content:
> Added a soundtrack
> Tarot cards were fixed to always display, no longer will you draw the same card twice and only get 3 in the end

I would also like to announce that the OST is coming to the Steam Store!

notes.title: TEEFAX IS OUT!
notes.content:
TEEFAX, a detective game set in the british version of Teletext has released! The game features completely new puzzles and a story different from the first game.
Also, this is the last teletext related game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2843530/TEEFAX_Cold_Case/

notes.title: Fullscreen optimizations
notes.content: Fixed some of the important text entry fields to display correctly on fullscreen

notes.title: Fullscreen and bugfixes!
notes.content:
> Progress now gets saved correctly
> Added a "fullscreen" mode ( NOT RECOMMENDED ) as it was requested by a lot of players

notes.title: End-game bufix
notes.content: 3 days back I added a Bamboozle! section, and only now I have realised the button that takes you there is unclickable thanks to your guys forum posts. This has been fixed!
